accepted.definition: (Maine colloquial) a temporary summer resident of Maine
accepted.simpleMeaning: a person who spends the summer in Maine but lives elsewhere the rest of the year.
accepted.scope: This is not an athletic activity, not a person who plays games, and not a way of showing off; it is a local Maine word for someone who stays in the state only for the summer.
examples: The old fisherman called the summer people sports.

accepted.definition: the relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)
accepted.simpleMeaning: the greater emphasis placed on a syllable or musical note, especially in terms of force or pitch.

accepted.definition: the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus
accepted.simpleMeaning: the feeling produced in the mouth when tiny sensors on the tongue and throat detect what a dissolved substance is made of.
accepted.scope: This is not the ability to judge what is good or beautiful, and not a personal liking for something; it is the physical sensation produced in the mouth by a dissolved substance.
examples: The medicine left a bitter taste in my mouth.
The soup had a strong taste of garlic.
